dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly irregular and non-continuous trailing edge spline characterized by multiple deep recursive notches and significant posterior tissue loss.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Jagged and truncated apex with a non-uniform radius resulting from acquired physical trauma.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with an approximate angular steepness of 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.2:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe structural damage consisting of a series of irregular notches and jagged serrations along the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; visible linear rake marks and cutaneous scratches across the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique multi-tiered notched profile of the trailing edge provides a distinct individual identifier.
